title: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE CONMSSION
SINDH PUBLIC
SERVICE CONMSSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I 8th December, 2001]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(39)/2001,
dated 8-12-2001.---Thefollowing Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Public Service
Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment in section 3 of Sindh Act XI of 1989

SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE CONMSSION
SINDH PUBLIC
SERVICE CONMSSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I 8th December, 2001]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(39)/2001,
dated 8-12-2001.---Thefollowing Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:-
3. Amendment in section 3 of
Sindh Act XI of 1989.--In the said Act, in section 3, for subsections (2)
and (3), the following shall be substituted:--
"(2) The Commission shall
consist of a Chairman and such number of members, not exceeding ten, as the
Governor may determine.
(3) Not less than one half of the
Members shall be the persons who have held office in the Service of Pakistan
for not less than twenty years including at least five years service in BPS-20
or above with outstanding career and eminence in their profession.
(4) The remaining members shall
be selected from private sector from amongst the eminent persons with minimum
age of forty five years and maximum age of sixty five years representing
liberal arts and science and professionals having a Bachelor's Degree with
sufficient practical experience in the relevant field.
(5) No person in the service of
Government or in autonomous Corporation or body established by Government by
law or otherwise shall be appointed as Member."

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment in section 4 of Sindh Act XI of 1989

SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE CONMSSION
SINDH PUBLIC
SERVICE CONMSSION
(AMENDMENT)

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I 8th December, 2001]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(39)/2001,
dated 8-12-2001.---Thefollowing Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:-
4. Amendment in section 4 of
Sindh Act XI of 1989.--In the said Act, in section 4, for subsections (2)
including the proviso, the following shall be substituted:
"(2) The Chairman or a
Member shall hold office for a single non renewable term of five years from the
date on which he enters upon his office; provided that the Governor may in his
discretion extend the term of the Chairman or a Member holding office on the
commencement of the Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance,
200.1 for a maximum period of five years including the term or terms already
served by him in office."
